urls.description: In the Research Article “Turf algae redefine the chemical landscape of temperate reefs, limiting kelp forest recovery” by S. P. Farrell et al. (22 May 2025, 10.1126/science.adt6788), values calculated as proportional increases in kelp gametophyte mortality (relative to paired controls) were incorrectly labeled and described as decreases in survival. Thus, although the reported effect sizes remain unchanged, the text should be interpreted as relative increases in mortality, and the y axis in Fig. 4 should read “Change in Mortality (%)” rather than “Change in Survival (%).” The underlying live/dead observations, calculations, and treatment-versus-control statistical comparisons are unchanged. As such, our correction to Fig. 4 and the associated Results text does not alter the interpretation of the allelopathy experiments or the overall conclusions of the study.
urls.title: Erratum for the Research Article “Turf algae redefine the chemical landscape of temperate reefs, limiting kelp forest recovery”
